title: Wildly Indulgent Irish Speck Stew
description: A hearty and indulgent Irish stew featuring speck, perfect for a cold winter's night, this dish is kosher-friendly and reduced to bring out the rich flavors.
instructions: In a large Dutch oven, cook the diced speck over medium heat until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the chopped onions to the pot and cook until they are translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic to the pot and cook for 1 minute.
Add the sliced carrots and cubed potatoes to the pot, stirring to combine.
Sprinkle the flour over the vegetables and cook for 1 minute.
Add the guinness stout, beef broth, apple cider vinegar, salt, and black pepper to the pot, stirring to combine.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, until the vegetables are tender, about 20 minutes.
Remove the pot from the heat and let it cool slightly before serving.
Serve the stew hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
